Help me create a personalized GTA-style character sheet for an AI gameplay video.

I have uploaded a photo of myself or the person I want to use. Your job is to ask a few customization questions, then write a complete image-generation prompt for Seedream 5.5.

FIRST, ASK ME:
1. What setting will the character appear in? For example: tropical beach, snowy village, futuristic city, desert, or medieval town.
2. What should the character wear? I can give you an exact outfit or ask you to suggest one that fits the setting.
3. Are there any accessories or appearance details I want to keep or add?

Ask these questions together in one short message. If I already supplied an answer, do not ask again. If I ask you to choose, make a suitable choice without more questions.

AFTER I ANSWER:
Return one complete, ready-to-paste Seedream 5.5 prompt in a code block. The image generator will receive only ONE reference image: the original photo, referenced as @ image1.

Build the prompt around these requirements:

IDENTITY
Preserve the reference person’s recognizable facial structure, hair color, hairstyle, skin tone, and visible distinguishing features. Translate them into a GTA-style playable character. Do not replace their identity with a generic game protagonist. Preserve visible body proportions; use natural proportions where the photo does not show the body.

RENDERING
Authentic GTA V-era in-game character graphics: moderately simplified facial geometry, game-resolution skin textures, conventional real-time shading, restrained surface detail, and readable clothing folds.

Hair should use textured game-model clumps that preserve the person’s hairstyle. Facial likeness should come from accurate shapes and proportions rather than photographic pore detail.

Keep the output sharp and detailed enough to use as a reference, but unmistakably game-rendered. Avoid photorealistic photography, glossy cinematic CGI, illustrated GTA loading-screen art, and exaggerated cartoon styling.

OUTFIT
Describe the chosen outfit concretely, including each garment’s color, fit, length, material, and footwear. Keep the same outfit and accessories across every panel. Avoid unnecessary logos and text. Keep the face and hairstyle visible unless I specifically request otherwise.

LAYOUT
One wide image containing three vertical panels separated by thin straight dividers:
— Left: a large front-facing head-and-upper-chest close-up, with the entire hairstyle visible.
— Center: full-body front view, including the entire head and both shoes.
— Right: full-body back view, including the entire head and both shoes.

The front and back figures have identical height, body proportions, clothing, and scale. Both use a relaxed upright stance with arms slightly away from the torso. Leave comfortable space above their heads and beneath their feet. Do not stretch, compress, or crop the figures.

BACKGROUND
Plain neutral gray background, even neutral lighting, and subtle grounding shadows. No environment, HUD, captions, labels, watermark, or additional characters.

Write the finished prompt with my choices already incorporated. Do not leave blanks or offer multiple alternatives.

布局
一张宽幅图像，包含三个竖向分格，由细直线分隔：
— 左：正面的大幅头部及上胸部特写，完整呈现发型。

背景
纯净的中性灰背景、均匀的中性光线，以及轻微的接地阴影。不要环境、HUD、字幕、标签、水印或其他角色。
